activation_condition: Only consider if the already-running independent natural workload does not expose a legal generated-history short recovery under the predeclared known_tokens <= 1792 condition. This file does not authorize or start an experiment.
selection_rule: First decision in recorded trajectory order with an already generated history, known_tokens <= the previously declared 1792 limit, a positive native Host hit and joint full GPU capacity; confirmed to have exactly one matching successful allocation. No latency, later output, alternative-action outcome or threshold scan was used to select this checkpoint.
hash_encoding: sha256(json.dumps(list(all_known_token_ids)).encode()) with standard json.dumps separators; prompt plus already generated tokens only.
online_contract: Only external identity, preemption ordinal, current known/generated counts and current prefix hash must match. Native positive ready Host hit and full joint GPU capacity are also required. Other decisions retain native Host behavior and native fallbacks. At most one successful target allocation commit per measured episode; no future output length, no future preemption/outcome condition, and no dual branch execution.
